## Checklist

- [ ] Tests cover the change and `cargo test` passes

- [ ] `cargo clippy --all-targets -- -D warnings` is clean
- [ ] `README.md`, `docs/spec.md`, and `CHANGELOG.md` are updated for any change a user would notice (or none is needed)
- [ ] Every commit is signed off (`git commit -s`, see [CONTRIBUTING.md](https://github.com/scogo-ai/synthlite/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md#sign-your-commits-dco))
- [ ] No API keys, tokens, or private prompts in code, tests, or fixtures
